title: Spectrum DM600HT Petrol Hedgetrimmer - 60cm Double Sided Blades
description_html:
Spectrum DM600HT Petrol Hedge Trimmer

Powerful, Lightweight Performance for Precision Hedge Maintenance

Take on demanding hedge trimming and shaping tasks with confidence using the Spectrum DM600HT Petrol Hedge Trimmer. Combining a lightweight design with robust construction and professional cutting performance, it’s the ideal choice for maintaining everything from ornamental shrubs to large established hedges.

At its heart is a high-performance 25.4cc two-stroke engine, delivering smooth, reliable power for fast and efficient cutting. Engineered for excellent fuel efficiency and dependable starting, it provides the performance needed to tackle thicker growth with ease.

Designed with operator comfort in mind, the DM600HT features an advanced anti-vibration system, using strategically positioned shock-absorbing springs to significantly reduce vibration transferred to the handles. This minimises fatigue during extended periods of use, making long trimming sessions far more comfortable.

The professional-grade aluminium gearbox offers exceptional strength while keeping overall weight to a minimum, while a bearing-mounted drive linkage reduces noise, vibration and component wear, helping to maximise durability and prolong service life.

Equipped with long, laser-cut double-sided blades, the DM600HT delivers fast, clean and precise cutting from either direction, making quick work of large hedges while producing a professional-quality finish. Its 28mm tooth spacing enables it to cut through thicker branches and mature growth with ease.

For greater versatility, the five-position rotating rear handle adjusts through 180°, allowing you to maintain a comfortable and natural working position whether trimming vertically, horizontally or at awkward angles.

Weighing just 5.4kg, the DM600HT remains easy to manoeuvre without compromising on power, while the transparent fuel tank lets you quickly monitor fuel levels, helping to minimise interruptions while you work.

Whether you’re maintaining formal hedges or tackling overgrown boundaries, the Spectrum DM600HT delivers the ideal combination of power, comfort and precision.
